correctness.rationale: For any fixed De Morgan chain the axioms reduce exactly to a midpoint (Pos) bound and a positive-prefix rigidity condition. Two exhaustive and disjoint families in each parity are independently counted by multiset coefficients; imposing top preservation removes one free upper value. The asymptotic normal proportion follows from exact binomial ratios. All monotone functions at n=2 through n=9 were exhaustively tested against the original axioms and normal forms in checker.py; the general proof is independent of the finite tests.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification over every finite De Morgan chain for a recently defined three-axiom modal expansion. It includes both normal and non-normal operators, exact parity-sensitive counts, and an asymptotic half-normal law. The lower-half rigidity phenomenon reveals the structural mechanism, and the precise counts serve as reproducible benchmarks for finite Kleene-modal model search. The invariant is motivated by the modal algebra itself rather than an arbitrary restricted statistic.
